title: platform-settings
description: An Admin changes platform settings. Only the settings sent change.

bootsDays.description: Boot records used for reboot-loop detection and crash timelines.

jobsDays.description: Fleet operation jobs and their per-cabinet results (the commands and the audit log stay).

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.

agents.description: How the agents pace themselves: the heartbeat answer carries these values (docs/spec/03-protocol.md Protocol 1.1).

pollSeconds.description: How long the server holds a command poll.

eventsPaceMs.description: Pause between event batches while an agent catches up after an outage.

drives.description: The drive risk thresholds (Healthy, Attention, High risk, Critical). The server also refuses a set whose steps do not rise.

wearAttentionPct.description: Percentage of rated life used at which a drive is Attention.

wearHighRiskPct.description: Percentage of rated life used at which a drive is High risk.

wearCriticalPct.description: Percentage of rated life used at which a drive is Critical.

wearDaysHighRisk.description: Projected days to 100% rated life at or under which a drive is High risk.

wearDaysCritical.description: Projected days to 100% rated life at or under which a drive is Critical.

temperatureAttentionC.description: Temperature in °C at which a drive is Attention.

temperatureHighRiskC.description: Temperature in °C at which a drive is High risk.

temperatureRiseAttentionC.description: Rise in °C over 30 days at which a drive is Attention.

reallocatedHighRiskPer7Days.description: New reallocated sectors in 7 days that make a drive High risk.

reallocatedCriticalPer30Days.description: New reallocated sectors in 30 days that make a drive Critical.

fleetPatternSites.description: A fleet pattern (decision-log D22): the same problem at this many sites raises one fleet alert.

fleetPatternHours.description: The window, in hours, in which those sites must have the problem.

fleetMinorAlarmSites.description: Fleet alarm level (decision-log D25): a major fleet pattern rings the alarm when it opens; a minor one only once it reaches this many sites.
